sum: Super League Enterprise, Inc. operates as an audience intelligence and media activation company. It connects brands with gaming population through advertising and branded content programs across gaming and digital media platforms. The company delivers these programs through its proprietary interactive formats, creator content, immersive experiences, data-driven insights, and strategic campaign services to enhance marketing performance. The company was formerly known as Super League Gaming, Inc. and changed its name to Super League Enterprise, Inc. in September 2023. Super League Enterprise, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, California.
ceo: Mr. Matthew Evan Edelman (President, CEO & Chairman)
